post.summary: Bir agent'i deneme amaciyla calistirir ve yaniti SSE ile akitir.
post.description: Kota asilmissa calistirma baslamaz ve 429 doner; ProblemDetails hangi kotanin asildigini ve sayacin ne zaman sifirlanacagini tasir. 'Idempotency-Key' basligi tasiyan bir istek SSE yerine tek bir JSON yanitla (akissiz) calisir — Faz 43'un tekillestirme sozlesmesi akissiz bir yanit gerektirir (docs/43-IDEMPOTENCY-KEY.md). 'Prefer: respond-async' basligi tasiyan bir istek calistirmayi kuyruga alir ve '202 Accepted' + 'Location' doner (Faz 46, docs/46-DAYANIKLI-CALISTIRMA.md). Kayitli bir IContentGuard icerigi engellerse akissiz yanit '422' doner ve runs.error_type 'content_blocked' olur; AKISLI yanitta durum kodu zaten gonderilmis oldugu icin engelleme SSE 'error' olayi olarak gorunur (Faz 48, docs/48-GUARDRAILS.md).

Kok calistirmanin iptali agactaki tum alt calistirmalari da durdurur; bir alt calistirmanin tek basina iptali koku etkilemez.

post.summary: Kayitli girdiyle yeni bir calistirma acar.
post.description: Girdi korunur, kosullar degisir: 'agentVersion', 'modelId' ve 'toolMode'. Varsayilan 'toolMode' degeri 'ReplayTools'tur ve HICBIR tool gercekten kosmaz — kayitli sonuclar geri oynatilir. Kayitli sonucu olmayan bir cagri oynatmayi DURDURUR ve 422 doner. 'LiveTools' tool'lari GERCEKTEN calistirir, yan etki uretir, Admin rolu ister ve onay gerektiren bir tool varsa 409 alir. Yeniden oynatma oturumsuzdur: kaynak calistirma bir oturumdaysa yalniz O TURUN girdisi oynatilir, konusma gecmisi tasinmaz.

name.description: Gets the unique name of the agent, used as the key in the catalog and in API routes.

displayName.description: Gets the name shown in the user interface. string AgentDefinition.Name is used when it is empty.

description.description: Gets a short description of what the agent does.

instructions.description: Gets the system instructions passed to the model.

model.description: Gets the provider and model binding to use.

toolNames.description:
Gets the names of the tools this agent may use. Every name must match a tool
registered in code; otherwise building the agent fails.

skillNames.description:
Gets the names of the skills this agent may load at run time. Every name must
match an enabled skill found in code or in the skill store.

callableAgentNames.description: Gets the names of the other agents this agent may call.

mcpResourceUris.description:
Gets the MCP resources added to the run context (mode A). Each item has the
form `"{server}:{uri}"`. They are read at the start of the run and are
predictable; every run receives the same resources.

oneOf.description:
Gets the harness settings. When `null` a plain chat agent is
produced; when populated, harness capabilities such as context compaction and
todo tracking are enabled.

Gets the context compaction settings. When `null` no compaction
is applied.

Gets the memory provider settings. When `null` no memory provider
is added.

origin.description: Gets the origin of the definition: code or database.

version.description:
Gets the definition version. Every save increments this value and so naturally
invalidates the compiled agent cache.

tenantId.description: Gets the tenant this definition belongs to. A single-tenant setup uses the default value.

updatedAt.description: Gets the time the definition last changed (UTC).

AgentDefinition.description:
The full definition of an agent. The same type is used whether the agent is
declared in code or stored in the database; AgentDefinitionOrigin AgentDefinition.Origin tells the two apart.

AgentDefinitionOrigin.description: Tells where an agent definition came from.

name.description: Agent adi. Katalogda benzersizdir.

model.description: Model baglantisi: saglayici, model ve ornekleme ayarlari.

toolNames.description:
Kullanilacak tool adlari. Tool'lar yalnizca kodda tanimlanir; burada
yalnizca kayitli bir tool'un adi verilebilir.

callableAgentNames.description: Bu agent'in cagirabilecegi diger agent adlari.

oneOf.description: Harness ayarlari. Bos birakilirsa duz sohbet agent'i derlenir.
Baglam sikistirma ayarlari. Bos birakilirsa sikistirma uygulanmaz.

name.description: Gets the unique name of the agent.

displayName.description: Gets the name shown in the user interface.

origin.description: Gets the origin of the definition.

sourceName.description:
Gets the name of the source that supplies this agent, for example `code`
or `database`. Several sources can share the same AgentDefinitionOrigin AgentDescriptor.Origin value.

version.description: Gets the definition version. It is always 1 for code agents.

oneOf.description: Gets the bound model. It can be unknown for code agents.

toolNames.description: Gets the names of the tools this agent may use.

skillNames.description: Gets the names of the skills this agent may load at run time.

callableAgentNames.description: Gets the names of the other agents this agent may call.

usesHarness.description: Gets whether the harness capabilities are enabled.

updatedAt.description: Gets the time of the last change (UTC).
